description:
This file is a shell script that monitors log messages for Utopia triggers, manages starting and stopping of a trigger handler, and interacts with system events.
It contains functions to start and stop a monitoring service, and a case statement to handle different command-line arguments for controlling the service.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the trigger monitoring service, initializes process ID, logs the start, and ensures the trigger handler is running.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the trigger monitoring service by killing the trigger handler process and updates the service status.
